title: Desert Traders
description: This datapack makes it so that wandering traders don't spawn with Llamas in the desert but with camels.
body:
# Desert Traders

This datapack makes wandering traders feel more at home in the desert.

When a wandering trader spawns in a desert biome, their llamas are replaced with camels instead.

The pack is simple, lightweight, and designed to stay close to vanilla gameplay.

**Features**

**Camels instead of llamas in deserts**
Wandering traders spawn with camels when they appear in desert biomes.

**Vanilla-friendly gameplay**
Trader behavior, trades, and mechanics stay the same.

**Lightweight datapack**
No mods required — works with vanilla Minecraft.

**Immersion improvement**
Traders match the environment when traveling through deserts.

**Multiplayer friendly**
Works on servers and in singleplayer worlds.

**Compatible with most datapacks**
Only changes wandering trader caravan animals in desert biomes.
